summary: The note describes the Church of San Pietro in Montorio, which was built on the site of an earlier 9th-century church dedicated to Saint Peter on Rome's Janiculum hill. The church functions as a shrine marking the supposed site of St. Peter's crucifixion.
one_line: San Pietro in Montorio is a church on Rome's Janiculum hill, built over a 9th-century Saint Peter church and serving as a shrine to Peter's supposed crucifixion site.
key_facts: The Church of San Pietro in Montorio was built on the site of an earlier 9th-century church.
The earlier church on the site was dedicated to Saint Peter.
The earlier 9th-century church stood on Rome's Janiculum hill.
The Church of San Pietro in Montorio serves as a shrine.
The shrine marks the supposed site of St. Peter's crucifixion.
